elements.name: Switch between adjacent document tabs using the keyboard

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open as adjacent tabs in that order
the first document tab is active
the user presses Control+Tab
the next document tab becomes active
its model browser and viewport are displayed
the first document remains open
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the first document tab becomes active again
the next document remains open

elements.name: Switch to the neighboring part with the keyboard

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open as neighboring tabs in that order
the left-hand part is active
the user presses Control+Tab
the right-hand part becomes active
its model browser and viewport are displayed
the left-hand part remains open

elements.name: Switch backward and forward between neighboring part tabs

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open as adjacent tabs in that order
the part on the right is active
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the part on the left becomes active
its viewport and model browser are displayed
the user presses Control+Tab
the part on the right becomes active again
its viewport and model browser are displayed

elements.name: Switch between Home and a neighboring part with the keyboard

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Home and the part window are adjacent in the tab strip
the part window is active with a sketch being edited
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the Home workspace and its recent documents are displayed
the part window remains open
the user presses Control+Tab
the part window's sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the sketch editing environment remains active

elements.name: Wrap keyboard navigation between Home and the last window

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd`, `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` and `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` are open
the user creates a second window for the profile part through View New
Home is the first tab and a part's second window is the last tab
Home is active
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the part's second window becomes active
the user presses Control+Tab
the Home workspace becomes active again
